details:
Minions in Space – Project Description

Our project is an interactive space story about Bob, a Minion astronaut who travels through space and discovers NASA's equipment left on the Moon and Mars. He meets the Apollo 17 Lunar Rover and the Sojourner rover, learning about their missions and scientific discoveries.

We created a handmade space model with Minions made of modeling clay, colorful planets, and electrical circuits with lights. We also used Scratch and Makey Makey to make the story interactive. By pressing the space bar, visitors can listen to Bob's adventure.

Our goal is to help children learn about NASA's missions in a fun and creative way. We want them to discover the history of space exploration and understand that even when a mission ends, its discoveries are not forgotten.

Our project combines storytelling, science, art, technology, and programming. We worked as a team, sharing ideas and using our creativity to make space exploration exciting, especially for younger children!
